title: The short version (decide these first)
body_md:
1. **Start as a sole proprietor** under your own PAN. Get Udyam registration (free) and a current account in the business name "Ampli" (or "Ampli Apps"). Move to a Private Limited company later, once revenue or investors justify it.
2. **Open a personal Google Play developer account now** ($25, about ₹2,100). Start the **12-tester / 14-day closed test** as early as possible, because it is the longest wait on your path. Add a website and support email under the Ampli brand.
3. **File the "AMPLI" trademark in Class 9 (and 42) early**, as an individual with a Udyam certificate (₹4,500 per class online). Run a search first, because similar marks exist.
4. **Hire a CA for about ₹5–15k a year.** They decide GST registration, GST TCS credit, ITR form and presumptive vs regular books.
5. **Lock down your signing keys and licences.** Use Play App Signing, back up the upload keystore offline, and get a Jamendo commercial licence or switch catalogue *before* production.

---

title: Business structure
body_md:
### 1.1 Options compared

| Structure | Setup cost (approx.) | Annual compliance | Liability | Good for |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Sole proprietorship** (PAN + Udyam + GST if needed + current account) | ₹0–3k (Udyam free; Shop & Establishment licence if your state requires it) | Personal ITR, GST returns if registered | **Unlimited** (personal assets at risk) | Starting now, low revenue |
| **One Person Company (OPC)** | ₹7–15k incl. DSC, name, SPICe+ (government fee is low for small capital) | ROC filings (AOC-4, MGT-7A), statutory audit, director KYC, ITR-6; often ₹15–30k a year with a CA | Limited | One founder who wants limited liability |
| **Private Limited (Pvt Ltd)** | ₹8–20k | As OPC plus board meetings and more forms; about ₹25–50k a year | Limited | Investors, ESOPs, hiring, DPIIT startup recognition |
| **LLP** | ₹6–12k | Form 8, Form 11, ITR-5; audit only above thresholds | Limited | **Needs 2 partners**, so not a fit right now |

Official portals: [MCA SPICe+](https://www.mca.gov.in/content/mca/global/en/mca/e-filing/incorporation.html) · [Udyam Registration (free, Aadhaar-based)](https://udyamregistration.gov.in/) · [GST portal](https://www.gst.gov.in/)

**Recommendation**
- **Now:** run as a sole proprietor, using your own PAN as the business identity. Register on Udyam as "Ampli" (enterprise type: micro, services, NIC code 62011 / 58202 for software publishing). Udyam gets you the lower trademark fee and MSME benefits.
- **Later:** incorporate a Pvt Ltd (or OPC) when any of these happens: revenue crosses roughly ₹10–20 lakh a year, you hire, you raise money, or you want liability protection (for example, Ampli Drive speed-camera alerts creating claim risk). The trademark and apps can then be **assigned** to the company. Play supports [transferring apps between developer accounts](https://support.google.com/googleplay/android-developer/answer/6230247).

**Gotcha:** some banks want a GST certificate or a Shop & Establishment certificate (not just Udyam) to open a proprietorship current account. Ask your bank which two proofs it accepts.

### 1.2 Personal vs organization Play account

| | Personal | Organization |
|---|---|---|
| Who | Individuals and sole proprietors | Registered legal entities |
| Extra docs | Government ID, Aadhaar-linked PAN for payments | **D-U-N-S number** ([free from Dun & Bradstreet](https://support.google.com/googleplay/android-developer/answer/13634885); avoid paid intermediaries), website, org phone/email |
| New-app testing | **Closed test with ≥12 testers opted in for 14 consecutive days** before production access (accounts created after 13 Nov 2023) ([Help](https://support.google.com/googleplay/android-developer/answer/14151465)) | Not required |
| Public developer info | Your legal name; address shown if you monetize | Organization name and address |

**Pick:** a personal account now. You can display the developer name as "Ampli", but your legal name and contact address may be shown publicly when you sell. Use a business address or a virtual office if you don't want your home address public **[VERIFY current display rules]**. When you incorporate, create an organization account and transfer the apps.

Also note: **Android developer verification** (registration of developer identity and package names) is rolling out. Play Console developers must register apps by 30 Sep 2026, and the requirement goes global in 2027 ([Android Developers Blog](https://android-developers.googleblog.com/2026/06/android-developer-verification.html)). Check Play Console Home for any "register your apps" banner.

---

title: Bank and getting paid
body_md:
**Documents:** PAN (Aadhaar-linked), Aadhaar, Udyam certificate, GST certificate if registered, and address proof.

1. **Current account** in the proprietorship name "Ampli". Keep app income out of your salary account so books stay clean. Ask for: a **SWIFT code**, foreign inward remittance support, and a way to download FIRA/FIRC or e-FIRA.
2. **Google Play payments profile** (Play Console → Setup → Payments profile):
   - Type: Individual (proprietor). Enter PAN. Google checks the PAN is Aadhaar-linked ([Google Payments: India tax info](https://support.google.com/paymentscenter/answer/15152449?hl=en-IN)).
   - Bank account for **wire transfer payouts** ([Help](https://support.google.com/googleplay/android-developer/answer/2700656)). Payouts arrive monthly once your balance clears the threshold.
   - A **FIRC** can be requested; requests are processed by BillDesk and issued by Citibank ([Help](https://support.google.com/paymentscenter/answer/7421525?hl=en-IN)). **[VERIFY]** in your payments profile which Google entity is the remitter and what currency your payouts use.
3. **AdMob payments** (separate from Play):
   - Payee is **Google Asia Pacific Pte. Ltd. (Singapore)**. Method in India: **wire transfer only**. Threshold: **US$100**. Address PIN verification happens at about **US$10** ([AdMob thresholds](https://support.google.com/admob/answer/2772208)).
   - Tax info: submit **W-8BEN** (individual) with PAN as the foreign tax ID. Claim treaty benefits so US withholding is typically 0% on non-US-source ad income. **[VERIFY with CA]**
   - Inward purpose code is usually **P1007 (advertising services)**. Ask the bank to tag it correctly and download the FIRA each month. Banks charge forex conversion fees plus 18% GST on them.
4. **RBI/FEMA:** money received from abroad must reach your bank through proper channels and be realised. An individual receiving export proceeds in INR is fine. Keep FIRA/FIRC per credit; your CA uses them for GST export claims ([RBI Master Direction on Export of Goods & Services](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_ViewMasDirections.aspx?id=10395)).

---

title: Tax (have a CA confirm every item here)
body_md:
### 3.1 What Google does for India-based developers
From [Google's India tax page](https://support.google.com/paymentscenter/answer/15152449?hl=en-IN) and [Play tax rates](https://support.google.com/googleplay/android-developer/answer/138000):
- Google **does not charge GST on your behalf** for Indian developers. *You* determine whether you need GSTIN and pay any GST on sales.
- Google **deducts income-tax TDS** on your Play earnings (now under Section 393 of the Income Tax Act, 2025, which replaced the old e-commerce TDS, Sec 194-O) and **collects GST TCS** (Sec 52 CGST). Both show up as credits you claim: TDS in Form 26AS/AIS, TCS in your GST ledger (only if you are GST-registered).
- If you hold a GSTIN, you must give it to Google. Google validates it.
- You are liable for GST under reverse charge on **Google's service fee** in some configurations. **[VERIFY]** whether this is RCM or charged by Google India.

### 3.2 GST registration: do you need it?
- **General threshold for services:** ₹20 lakh turnover (₹10 lakh in special-category states).
- **Selling through an e-commerce operator (ECO) that collects TCS** normally triggers compulsory registration (Sec 24). But **Notification 65/2017-Central Tax** exempts *service suppliers* through ECOs below the threshold. **[VERIFY]**: digital app sales are services, so you are probably not compelled below ₹20 lakh. But Google collecting TCS without your GSTIN makes credit-claiming awkward.
- **Sales to buyers outside India** and **AdMob income** are generally export of services, zero-rated. If registered, file a **LUT** each year to export without paying IGST.
- **Practical take:** many small developers register voluntarily from day one. It costs about ₹0–2k plus monthly or quarterly returns, and lets you claim TCS and simplifies bank KYC. Below ₹20 lakh you may skip it. Let your CA choose.

### 3.3 Income tax
- Income goes in your personal return as **business/profession income**.
- **Presumptive scheme:** the old Sec 44AD (business, 6% of digital receipts as profit) and 44ADA (specified professions, 50%) are merged into **Section 58 of the Income Tax Act, 2025** from 1 April 2026 ([TaxGuru summary](https://taxguru.in/income-tax/presumptive-taxation-simplified-income-tax-act-2025-merges-44ad-44ada-44ae.html)). App publishing is usually treated as *business* (ITR-4 under the 6%/8% option). **[VERIFY]**, because some CAs treat it differently. Software development as such is not one of the classic "specified professions".
- **ITR form:** ITR-4 (presumptive) or ITR-3 (regular books) for income received up to 31 Mar 2026. Forms are being re-notified under the new Act. File via the [Income Tax e-filing portal](https://www.incometax.gov.in/).
- **Advance tax** is due if your tax liability is above ₹10,000 a year. Presumptive taxpayers pay 100% by 15 March.
- If you also have salary income, it's still one return. Tell your CA.
- **Get a CA.** Budget ₹5–15k a year as a proprietor and ₹25k or more as a company. Look for one who has handled AdSense/AdMob and Play clients.

---

title: Google Play Console, end to end
body_md:
Official start: [Create a Play Console developer account](https://support.google.com/googleplay/android-developer/answer/6112435).

| # | Step | Notes / gotchas |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Create account at play.google.com/console with a **dedicated Google account** (e.g. ampli.apps@…) | $25 one-time. Turn on 2-Step Verification. |
| 2 | Identity verification | Government ID matching your legal name. Phone and email verification. Takes a few days. |
| 3 | Developer profile | Developer name "Ampli" (or "Ampli Apps"), website, support email. |
| 4 | Payments profile | See §2. Required before you can create `ampli_pro` or paid apps. |
| 5 | **Create app** | Package names are permanent (e.g. `app.ampli.player`, `app.ampli.drive`). Default language. App vs game; free vs paid. **A free app can never become paid**: keep both free with in-app Pro. |
| 6 | Store listing | Icon 512×512; feature graphic 1024×500; 2–8 phone screenshots (**real device captures, not mockups**); short description (80 characters); full description (4000). No "best/No.1" claims, no third-party logos (Spotify, Android Auto badge misuse). |
| 7 | **Privacy policy URL** | Required (you use ads, network and permissions). Host it free on GitHub Pages or your domain (see §7). |
| 8 | **App content** forms | Data safety ([Help](https://support.google.com/googleplay/android-developer/answer/10787469)): declare AdMob's data collection (device IDs, approximate location, diagnostics) plus Jamendo/AudD network calls. Also content rating (IARC questionnaire), target audience (18+ or 13+; *not* children, to keep ads simple), the ads declaration ("contains ads" = Yes for Ampli), news/government = No, and financial features = No. |
| 9 | **Permissions declarations** | Ampli: `READ_MEDIA_AUDIO`/`READ_MEDIA_VIDEO` (core media player: allowed), `FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK`, `POST_NOTIFICATIONS`. Ampli Drive: `BIND_NOTIFICATION_LISTENER_SERVICE` (needs a clear in-app disclosure; reviewers check it), location (foreground; **background location needs a separate declaration and video**, so avoid it if you can), and the launcher `HOME` intent. Declare each **foreground service type** with a reason and video in Play Console ([FGS requirements](https://support.google.com/googleplay/android-developer/answer/13392821)). Speed-camera alerts: show "for information only, obey the law". |
| 10 | **App signing** | Enrol in **Play App Signing**: Google holds the app signing key; you hold an **upload key**. Back up `upload.jks` plus passwords offline (password manager plus an encrypted USB). If you lose the upload key, you can request a reset; the app signing key is never lost. |
| 11 | **Build AAB in GitHub Actions** | Store the keystore as a base64 secret (`UPLOAD_KEYSTORE_B64`) plus `KEYSTORE_PASSWORD`, `KEY_ALIAS`, `KEY_PASSWORD`. Decode it at build time; never commit it. Bump `versionCode` each upload. Target the current required API level ([target API policy](https://support.google.com/googleplay/android-developer/answer/11926878)). Upload `mapping.txt` for crash deobfuscation. |
| 12 | Internal testing | Up to 100 testers, available in minutes. Use it to test billing. |
| 13 | **Closed testing: 12+ testers, 14 consecutive days** | Testers must stay opted in for the full 14 days. A tester who opts out restarts their own count. Recruit 15–20 friends with Android phones and give them the opt-in link. Then apply for production and answer the questions about your test ([Help](https://support.google.com/googleplay/android-developer/answer/14151465)). **One closed test per app**, so Ampli Drive needs its own. |
| 14 | **In-app product `ampli_pro`** | Monetize → One-time products. Set the price in INR; Play auto-converts other countries. Integrate Play Billing Library (current major version), **acknowledge purchases within 3 days** or they auto-refund, and verify on device. Ampli Drive: e.g. `drive_pro` at ₹499. |
| 15 | License testers | Setup → License testing: add Gmail accounts so test purchases aren't charged. |
| 16 | Production + **staged rollout** | Start at 10–20%, watch Android vitals and crashes, then 100%. Review takes from hours to 7+ days. |
| 17 | Service fee | Currently **15% on the first US$1M a year** if you enrol in the 15% tier (enrol your account group; it is not automatic). Google announced a new fee structure with India / "rest of world" changes from 30 Sep 2027 ([Help](https://support.google.com/googleplay/android-developer/answer/16954621)). |

**Music-specific gotcha:** your online catalogue must be licensed for commercial use. Jamendo's free API terms are **non-commercial**. An app with ads and Pro is commercial, so get a [Jamendo commercial licence](https://devportal.jamendo.com/) or switch to Internet Archive items with clear CC licences, and show attribution. Otherwise expect IP takedowns. The same applies to song recognition (AudD paid key, per their terms) and speed-camera data (check the source's licence; OpenStreetMap is ODbL and needs attribution).

---

title: AdMob
body_md:
1. Create an account at [admob.google.com](https://admob.google.com/) with the same Google account. Accept terms.
2. **Add app** → later **link to the Play listing** once it's live. Ads serve properly only after the app is approved ([App readiness](https://support.google.com/admob/answer/10564477)).
3. **Ad units:** banner (library), interstitial (sparingly), and rewarded ("unlock Pro theme for 24h"). Use **test ad IDs** during development, and never click your own ads (invalid-traffic bans are common).
4. **app-ads.txt:** put `google.com, pub-XXXXXXXX, DIRECT, f08c47fec0942fa0` at `https://ampli.<tld>/app-ads.txt`, the **root of the developer website listed in Play** ([Help](https://support.google.com/admob/answer/9363762)).
5. **Consent (UMP SDK):** create a GDPR message (EEA/UK/CH) and a US state regulations message in AdMob → Privacy & messaging; call UMP before loading ads ([Help](https://support.google.com/admob/answer/10113207)). Also comply with India's **DPDP Act 2023** (rules notified 2025): get clear consent and offer a way to withdraw.
6. **Pro removes ads:** gate ad loading on the Pro entitlement.
7. **Payments:** see §2 (W-8BEN, wire, US$100).
8. Ampli Drive: avoid ads while driving. Disable them on drive screens (safety, and driving-mode policy expectations).

---

title: Brand and IP protection
body_md:
**Honest truth:** **ideas, features and "a music player with X" cannot be owned.** Anyone can build a competing launcher. You *can* protect the **name and logo** (trademark), your **code, artwork, text and videos** (copyright, automatic), and your **signing identity and accounts**.

### 6.1 Trademark "AMPLI"
- **Search first** on the [IP India public search](https://tmrsearch.ipindia.gov.in/eregister/) (wordmark, phonetic, Classes 9/41/42). Known risks from a quick web scan: an iOS app called "Ampli", Amplitude's developer tool "Ampli", and "AMPLIFi"/"AmpliTube" (music/guitar). "Ampli" is also short for amplifier, so the bare word may draw a descriptiveness objection in audio contexts. **A device mark (logo plus word) or "AMPLI" plus a distinctive element may register more easily.** Pay an IP attorney about ₹2–5k for a clearance search.
- **Classes:** **9** (downloadable software and apps, the must-have), **42** (software services / SaaS), **41** (online music/entertainment services, optional), and later **35**/**12** if you sell hardware.
- **Fee (TM-A, e-filing):** **₹4,500 per class** for individuals, startups and MSMEs with a Udyam certificate attached; ₹9,000 otherwise ([IP India fee schedule](https://ipindia.gov.in/); summary at [Intepat](https://www.intepat.com/blog/trademark-registration-fees-india)). Attorney fees run about ₹2–6k per class. File as "Vikash Parashar trading as Ampli", with a **user date** (first use) or "proposed to be used".
- **Timeline:** you get the application number the same day, and can use **™** immediately. Examination comes in about 1–3 months, then possibly an objection reply (1 month), journal publication, and a 4-month opposition window. Registration typically takes **12–24 months**. Use **®** only after registration (misuse is an offence). Renew every 10 years.
- Later: assign the mark to your company (Form TM-P). For abroad, use the Madrid Protocol via IP India.

### 6.2 Copyright, designs, patents
- **Code, UI art, icons, videos and listing text** are copyrighted automatically. Optional registration with the [Copyright Office](https://copyright.gov.in/) (about ₹500 per work for literary works/software) helps in disputes. Keep dated Git history as evidence.
- **Design registration** covers the shape or configuration of articles, so it doesn't usefully cover app UIs. **Patents** for software "per se" are excluded in India (Sec 3(k)). Skip both.
- **Trade secrets:** keep backend keys, AudD keys and signing keys private, and obfuscate with R8.

### 6.3 Domains and handles
Buy **one primary domain** (ampli.app / ampli.in / getampli.com, whichever is free) plus the obvious variants if cheap. Reserve @ampli-style handles on YouTube, Instagram, X and Reddit early.

### 6.4 If someone copies you
1. Collect evidence: screenshots, listing URL, dates, and your Git history.
2. **Play Store:** file an [IP infringement complaint](https://support.google.com/legal/answer/3110420) (copyright, or trademark once filed or registered). Google can remove copycat listings or ones that impersonate "Ampli".
3. Websites and other stores: DMCA or copyright notice to the host.
4. In India: a **cease-and-desist legal notice** through an advocate (₹3–10k). Trademark infringement and passing-off suits go to a commercial court (expensive; last resort).

---

title: Website and domain
body_md:
- **Domain:** about ₹700–1,500 a year (.in / .com). Use a registrar with free WHOIS privacy (Cloudflare, Porkbun, Namecheap).
- **Hosting:** free on **GitHub Pages** or Cloudflare Pages: a one-page site per app plus `/privacy`, `/terms` and `/app-ads.txt` at the root.
- **Privacy policy must cover:** what you collect (none locally; AdMob identifiers; Jamendo/Internet Archive/AudD requests; Drive location and notification access processed on-device), third-party SDK links, retention, children (not directed at under-13s), contact details, DPDP rights (access, correction, erasure, grievance contact), and effective date. One policy per app, or one combined policy with app sections.
- **Support email:** support@yourdomain (Cloudflare Email Routing, free → Gmail; or Zoho Mail free tier).
- **Data deletion:** if you ever add accounts, Play requires a deletion URL.

---

title: Marketing (later, briefly)
body_md:
- **YouTube channel** "Ampli" for the promo videos (remake the female voice-over at launch) and short demos.
- **Meta Business Suite** (Facebook/Instagram page, ads account) and **Google Ads App campaigns** (Play-linked). Only run ads after ratings stabilise.
- Ad spend from your current account: Google Ads India bills in INR with GST. Keep invoices; they are deductible expenses (except under presumptive tax).
- Before launch, set up the Play **pre-registration** and **promo codes** for `ampli_pro` (influencers, testers).

---

title: Master timeline (realistic)
body_md:
| Week | Do |
|---|---|
| 1 | Udyam; Play account; domain plus GitHub Pages site plus privacy policy; TM search |
| 1–2 | Bank current account; payments profile; AdMob account; file TM Class 9 (+42) |
| 2 | Upload signed AAB to internal, then closed test; recruit 15–20 testers |
| 2–4 | 14-day closed test; fix licences (Jamendo/IA), real screenshots, Data safety |
| 4–5 | Apply for production; staged rollout; link AdMob; app-ads.txt |
| 6+ | Ampli Drive: its own closed test (parallel if possible); CA review before 31 March |

The full checklist is in `checklist.json` in this folder.
